caption: United States ex rel. Silbersher v. Janssen Biotech, Inc.
citation_line: United States ex rel. Silbersher v. Janssen Biotech, Inc., No. 2:19-cv-12107, ECF No. 454 (D.N.J. Sept. 22, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied a False Claims Act relator's objection to a special master's privilege ruling after independently reviewing fifty documents. The court distinguished the threshold for in camera review from the higher showing needed to defeat privilege under the crime-fraud exception.
qualification_rationale: A useful intersection of Rule 53 review, special-master management, attorney-client privilege, and crime-fraud doctrine in complex pharmaceutical litigation.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery ruling; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_label: Attorney Client Privilege and Crime Fraud
